chunk: Roman Alexeev was born on December 21, 1991, in Moscow, Russia. Growing up in a family of journalists, Roman was exposed to the world of writing and storytelling from a young age. He attended Gymnasium No. 534, where he developed a passion for literature and language.

After completing his secondary education, Roman enrolled in Lomonosov Moscow State University, where he pursued a degree in Journalism. During his university years, Roman was actively involved in the student newspaper, honing his writing skills and building a network of contacts in the industry.

Upon graduating from university, Roman landed a job as an associate editor at Vedomosti, a prominent Russian newspaper. He quickly proved himself to be a diligent and meticulous editor, earning the respect of his colleagues and superiors.

In his personal life, Roman is a private person who values his relationships deeply. He is known for his empathetic nature and strong listening skills, which have helped him build strong bonds with his friends and family.

Despite his professional success, Roman struggles with anxiety and self-doubt, often finding it difficult to open up to others about his feelings. This introspective nature has led him to develop a strong sense of self-awareness and introspection.
Roman currently resides in Moscow, where he continues to work as an associate editor at Vedomosti.
